title: StudioDiscardResult
description: The answer to POST /lessons/:lessonId/facets/:facet/discard (2.18.0). 200 either way: `discarded: false, noop: true` when there was no draft (a second Confirm).

state.description: Only with noop: the state of the version that has no draft.

version.description: The live version the lesson stays on (only when discarded).

withdrawn.description: Comments of the draft that were withdrawn (only when discarded).
